hyde.passage: AMP-activated protein kinase (AMPK) activation has been shown to promote inflammation-associated fibrotic remodeling in the lung. Studies using pharmacologic activators and genetic approaches report increased fibrotic markers, including collagen deposition and profibrotic signaling, following AMPK activation. These effects are linked to enhanced inflammatory pathway activity that drives lung fibrosis.
